_doc: Condensed outlines (coarse-graining skill): compress (the writer condenses the edited notes into outline.md;
the check measures words against the unit's allowance, so an overrun gets one retry that quotes it) -> fidelity
(a reviewer lists every outline statement that the notes do not support or that is stronger than the notes) ->
status-outline. It extends rollout.outlines.example.json (units and variables) but runs in a workdir of its own,
because every run writes <its workdir>/<unit>/STATUS: the outline's fidelity status (FAITHFUL or ISSUES) is
<this run's workdir>/<unit>/STATUS, and the published status of the notes (EDITED or COMPARED) stays in
<outlines_workdir>/<unit>/STATUS, which this run never writes. The notes are seeded from the outline run's edit
stage (<outlines_workdir>/<unit>/edit/notes.md); to condense notes made elsewhere, point 'seed' at a file named
Allowance: one page (about 500 words) per 4,000 Lean lines, at least 3 and at most 10 pages, 10% tolerance
(outline_budget.py). A still-over outline after the retry fails the stage: decide it by hand, do not loop.
workdir: SET-ME: working directory for the compression stages, not the outline run's (outside the skills repository)

vars.outlines_workdir: SET-ME: the workdir of the outline run (rollout.outlines.example.json), whose <unit>/edit/notes.md are condensed
